meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided, and on what basis?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me what you actually have against Owen's essay.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.

Turn the screen, Hale, I want to read it myself. I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58, the night before it was due. Owen told me he wrote it over the weekend, so where is the weekend in that history?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.

I'm writing down Act 3, Scene 2, and that line, and I'll search it myself tonight. A misquoted line is a misquoted line, Hale, it isn't a verdict on my son. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

Then I want "nothing goes on his record" in an email from you tonight, cc the principal, before Owen sits down for anything. Thursday at 8:15, in your room, no other students, and nobody in his class hears a word about it. He'll do it to put this behind him, Hale, not because he did anything.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you proposed a supervised rewrite in your room on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal supervising, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing going on Owen's record. I still require that promise about his record in writing from you, and I require that no other students are present and nobody in his class hears about it. I expect that written confirmation from you tonight, before Owen sits down for anything.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position, accepting a private supervised rewrite on Thursday morning, while still wanting a written promise that nothing goes on Owen's file and that his class never hears of it.
What moved her: showing the document's version history with exact times, because it was specific, dated, tied to Owen's own essay and something she could read herself.
What cost ground: nothing, because you owned the early zero in one sentence and never leaned on the detector or called Owen a liar.
Try next time: when she asked where the weekend was in that history, answer that question directly before moving on to the misquoted line, so her own case is closed on the record rather than left hanging.
